scope.description: Software vendors that compete with zvoove Clean brands for cleaning companies' planning, time, quality, payroll and invoicing budgets in DACH, Benelux, the Nordics and the UK.
scope.inclusionLogic: Included: cleaning-specific all-in-one tools named in 2026 German comparison articles, generic frontline and time-tracking apps that cleaning companies use as substitutes, Dynamics-based ERPs for service providers, and the leading North American janitorial specialist as a benchmark. Excluded: zvoove Clean's own brands.
scope.notes: Most competitors are private and publish no comparable metrics; stats are omitted rather than estimated. zvoove Clean's own figures (2,500+ customers, 250,000 cleaners, 15+ countries) are company-reported.

players.name: PlanD
players.description: Cleaning-focused software combining scheduling, time tracking, payroll and invoicing in one system and app; direct competitor to fortytools.

players.name: Blink
players.description: Frontline employee app (chat, time tracking with GPS, shift planning, leave) widely used by cleaning and facility companies as a substitute for cleaning-specific apps.

players.name: Crewmeister (ATOSS Group)
players.description: Mobile time tracking via GPS, NFC and QR with DATEV integration for small and mid-sized firms including cleaning; part of ATOSS.

players.name: Profacilo
players.description: Cleaning software for scheduling and invoicing with object-based administration for small companies.

players.name: HERO Software
players.description: Trades software (quotes, orders, invoices, mobile app) that also targets building cleaners.

players.name: BSS (Dynamics 365 Business Central solutions)
players.description: ERP for cleaning, staffing and security service providers built on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.

players.name: clockin
players.description: Mobile time tracking and documentation app positioned for building cleaners.

players.name: Swept
players.description: Operational software for commercial cleaning and janitorial businesses (scheduling, payroll support, supplies, inspections, client communication); benchmark for a cleaning-specific platform outside Europe.
